summary.intent: Refactor so that a note (diagnostic message) emitted during workspace/project discovery fires only once per command rather than twice, on a branch named refactor/note-without-global.
summary.outcome: A subagent investigated and stopped without changing, committing, or pushing any code, because fixing it requires a signature change and a 'who prints' decision that it had been told to stop on. It did identify why the notes fire twice.

repo: Branch refactor/note-without-global exists locally at origin/main (e916c1f96); origin/main may be stale because git fetch was blocked by the sandbox.
Both notes are side effects of the locator walk in walk.rs::discover and locate/ignore_walk.rs, so any command that walks the workspace more than once emits them more than once.
`init` loads the workspace twice in commands/init.rs (detect, then preview).
Release flows load once via load_workspace, then validate_release_intent loads again via Workspace::load in commands/release/capability.rs.

code.finding: init loads the workspace twice (detect, then preview), causing duplicate notes.
validate_release_intent calls Workspace::load a second time after load_workspace, causing duplicate notes.
discover emits notes as a side effect of the locator walk.

friction: git fetch was blocked by the sandbox, so origin/main may be out of date.
No single once-per-command emission point exists, so the fix is not a local change.
open_items: Decide who prints the notes and how to carry them up, e.g. have ProjectLocator::projects_and_platform_candidates return them.
Add a quiet second-load path for init (detect then preview) and for release validate_release_intent / capability.rs.
Get user approval for the signature/parameter change before implementing.
Run verify steps, including private_workspace_root_tests.rs, once a change is made.
